announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: 1.2.2 Will Be Ready Soon
announcements.body: We just finished testing the app, and I will upload it soon!

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: Freeze Method Reverted for Upcoming 1.2.2 Later
announcements.body:
I tried a new freeze method to keep your home screen icons in place after unfreezing. In testing, frozen apps kept restarting in the background, which defeats the point of freezing.

So I reverted to the old method. Apps stay fully off while frozen, but their icons disappear and may move around when restored. I'd rather have frozen apps actually stay frozen.

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: DPI Issue Fix Ready
announcements.body: Good news! I've resolved the DPI and screen size issues affecting specific devices. The fix isn't live just yet, but it will be rolled out in the upcoming update. Thanks for waiting!

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: DPI Issue
announcements.body:
I'm aware of DPI and screen size issues on specific devices and am currently working on a fix. Please stay tuned for updates.

You can still lower the resolution if you really need the extra performance, but I advise avoiding it if you don't have to.

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: DrionTune Without Developer Options
announcements.body:
Someone found a new way to use DrionTune with disabled Developer Options.
I'm testing and preparing it now so setup will be much easier. Stay tuned for the upcoming update!

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: GCash / GoTyme Pro Keys Temporarily Paused
announcements.body:
Manual GCash and GoTyme Pro key issuance is temporarily paused while we upgrade our local key system.

For instant Pro activation, please use Gumroad in the Pro tab. Existing Pro keys continue to work normally. GCash support will return in the next update!

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: DrionTune v1.2.1 Is Live!
announcements.body:
v1.2.1 hotfix is out:
• Defers cold-start trial reset & "Restore Now" notification taps until Shizuku connects (protects stock snapshots)
• Fixes "Watch Ad" button hanging if ad init fails
• Moves QR save to background thread, disables update cache, & adds unknown-apps install prompt
• Live 30s trial countdown + safer external link handling
